submitted.rationale: I aimed for the FeVO4-like region (Fe:V close to 1:1) with small amounts of Cr. With Fe held at about 0.41, EQE went up each time Cr went down: 0.141% at Cr 0.15 (index 103), 0.194% at Cr 0.10 (index 75) and 0.209% at Cr 0.08 (index 61). Index 61 is the highest-EQE composition I measured.

rejected.reason: 0.141% EQE; more Cr lowered the EQE
The Cr trend I measured points away from Cr-rich films, and the V-rich region is far from the FeVO4 phase. Neither was measured.
